_comment: The corpus version, declared once and read by everything that needs it: run.mjs copies
it into out/manifest.json, decoy-compile-corpus reads it from there, and the Swift tests
read this file directly. Before this existed the number lived in the compiler's default,
whichever --corpus-version flag you happened to type, and two test files -- so every bump
broke two tests by hand and CI built 1.0.0 while the tests asserted 11.0.0.
This is part of the reproducibility contract, not a build detail. generate(seed:) is only
reproducible with respect to a particular corpus. Adding data is a minor bump; changing or
removing an existing value is a MAJOR bump, because it silently changes every fixture an
existing user has already generated. See docs/corpus-strategy.md.
